div.div: A failed file never stops the import: read errors, archive limits (1 GiB per entry, 4 GiB per archive), empty or binary files, no matching importer, no events and contained panics (a crashed plugin process too) become an UnrecognizedFile with its reason. Cancelled files are listed as “Not imported”. Plugin importers run in their own sandboxed process behind Guarded* adapters (failures counted, quarantined after 3); readers keep working while an import runs.
